description: This file defines an internal interface ISiloControl within the Orleans namespace, which includes asynchronous methods for managing and retrieving information about silos, grains, and runtime statistics in an Orleans distributed system.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Sends a ping message to check connectivity.

methods.name: ForceGarbageCollection
methods.description: Triggers garbage collection on the silo.

methods.name: ForceActivationCollection
methods.description: Forces activation collection based on an age limit.

methods.name: ForceRuntimeStatisticsCollection
methods.description: Collects runtime statistics from the silo.

methods.name: GetRuntimeStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves runtime statistics of the silo.

methods.name: GetDetailedGrainStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves detailed statistics for grains, optionally filtered by types.

methods.name: GetDetailedGrainReport
methods.description: Provides a detailed report for a specific grain.

methods.name: GetActivationCount
methods.description: Returns the current count of active grain activations.

methods.name: MigrateRandomActivations
methods.description: Migrates a specified number of random grain activations to a target silo.

methods.name: SendControlCommandToProvider
methods.description: Sends a control command to a specified provider.

methods.name: GetActiveGrains
methods.description: Retrieves a list of active grains of a specific type.

calls: Task<object> SendControlCommandToProvider<T>(string providerName, int command, object arg) where T : IControllable
